name: marketing-machine
tagline_zh: 从扫描代码到出图出片，一条龙自动跑完。你只丢一句需求，它自己搭台、写稿、审规、渲染，连卡片和视频都按同一份HTML。
tagline_en: Scan code, write copy, enforce rules, render PNG & MP4 from one HTML contract. Just say the word—it runs the.
desc_en: Own the whole marketing content pipeline for this codebase — set itself up, scan the product for what actually works, write the copy, enforce the rules mechanically, and render cards (PNG) and video (MP4) from one HTML contract. Use for "set up marketing", "write a post", "review this copy", "make a card for this", "render a video", "scan the product", or "do the whole thing".
why_zh: 同类工具只写文案，它却把产品扫描、规则校验和视觉渲染焊成一条链，且所有输出共用一份HTML契约。
why_en: Unlike copy-only tools, it welds product scanning, rule enforcement, and PNG/MP4 rendering into one pipeline—all from a single.
